publicPrefix: The renderer serves GLBs from the web public dir: strip the leading 'apps/web/public' from each glb path to get the browser URL (e.g. 'apps/web/public/assets/x.glb' -> '/assets/x.glb'). Repo-relative paths are the reviewable source of truth.

notes.authority: All warehouse POSITIONS come from the fixture. This file binds fixture IDs to sourced GLB assets plus measured source bounds/scaling. It invents no positions; shell placements are explicit below and the fit proof verifies walls/entrances lie outside the planning boundary.
notes.containers: unitDimsMm are CEILING integers of the measured sourced-container geometry (W1 fit authority) and the fit proof re-checks them against actual GLB POSITION buffers.
notes.aggregation: unitsPerVisual is the declared item count per rendered container. Every stocked quantity must be an exact multiple (checked by the fit proof via containersForStock); fractional containers do not exist.
notes.unusedDecks: Rack deck index 2 (top, 2330 mm) carries no modeled slots in any rack; it renders bare and is explicitly not counted.
notes.carry: Cargo-C2: carried loads are aggregated picked items in 2 equipment crates x 2 fixed 220x320x160 cells (capacity 4, universal cargo yaw90). The carry packet is the single source of cart/tote bounds, normalization, docks, cells, profile, and capacity; the renderer consumes it and refuses drifted geometry. Carried items render as labeled wireframe bounds markers sized from canonical SKU dims, never as solid inventory models or whole storage boxes.

walls.placementRule: GLB Y-up bounds x -0.40..0.34, z -6..0. yaw -90 maps length onto +X (north walls span x 0..24, z -0.74..0, outside). yaw 0 keeps length on -Z (west walls span x -0.74..0, z 0..18, outside). East side stays open for the cutaway view.

entrances.placementRule: GLB Y-up bounds x -0.40..4.37, z -12..0. yaw +90 maps x' = z, z' = -x: wall body (x -0.40..0.34) lands at room z 18.00..18.74 (outside); doorway (source y 3..9) centers on centerXMm spanning +-3 m; barriers and door side bodies land inside as registered OB-*-B* and OB-*-D* obstacles (mirrored about the doorway center, asset is symmetric). Carpet floor finish is a non-obstructing floor visual (documented in fixture provenance). Overhead beams/mounts/glass above 3.6 m are non-obstructing.
entrances.boundaryBehavior: Wall bodies are outside the planning boundary (display-only shell, clipped above 2.5 m). Door openings are visual; no engine movement exists in this static part, so no traversal is claimed. Service/queue points near the carpet are valid floor positions.
